# scm_dlp_endpoint_policy (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Retrieves details of an Enterprise DLP Endpoint Policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP endpoint policy by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_endpoint_policy" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the endpoint policy.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the endpoint policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint policy is enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint policy.
- `priority` (Number) Priority order of the endpoint policy.
- `response_json` (String) JSON object representing the policy response/action.
- `scope_json` (String) JSON object representing the policy scope.
- `severity` (String) Severity level: informational, low, medium, high, or critical.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `type` (String) Policy type: endpoint_peripheral_control, endpoint_data_in_motion, or network.
